description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing 'Dish' entities within the Coocook project. It includes methods for viewing, creating, updating, deleting, and repositioning dishes and their ingredients, as well as handling AJAX requests related to dishes.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Dish
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing dishes in the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets the dish object in the stash based on the provided ID, used as a chained method for other actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit page for a dish, including ingredients, related meals, and recipe info.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a dish and redirects to project edit page.

methods.name: delete_ajax
methods.description: Deletes a dish via AJAX and returns success status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dish related to a meal, via AJAX.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a dish from a recipe, via AJAX.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates dish ingredients based on servings.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an ingredient to a dish.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions an ingredient within a dish.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the edit page for a dish.
